key: frontier - elite ii (1993)(gametek)(disk 1 of 2)[cr csl]/Frontier - Elite II (1993)(GameTek)(Disk 1 of 2)[cr CSL].adf:Frontier:5:29640
name: multiply_vector_by_matrix
description: Computes two output values as dot products of three input words with three matrix entries each, doubling every product and keeping its high word. The two results are returned packed into one 64-bit value.

key: frontier - elite ii (1993)(gametek)(disk 1 of 2)[cr csl]/Frontier - Elite II (1993)(GameTek)(Disk 1 of 2)[cr CSL].adf:Frontier:5:29694
name: clamp_three_values_to_limits
description: Clamps three signed input values to the minimum and maximum limit pairs stored in the structure. It then writes the three clamped results into consecutive words of that structure.

key: frontier - elite ii (1993)(gametek)(disk 1 of 2)[cr csl]/Frontier - Elite II (1993)(GameTek)(Disk 1 of 2)[cr CSL].adf:Frontier:5:296A6
name: floor_first_and_clamp_outputs
description: Raises the first value to at least a floor passed in a register, clamps the second and third values to limit pairs from the structure, and stores all three as words.

key: frontier - elite ii (1993)(gametek)(disk 1 of 2)[cr csl]/Frontier - Elite II (1993)(GameTek)(Disk 1 of 2)[cr CSL].adf:Frontier:5:296B0
name: store_and_clamp_last_two
description: Stores the first input word unchanged in the structure, clamps the second and third values to their limit pairs, and stores both clamped results in the following words.

key: frontier - elite ii (1993)(gametek)(disk 1 of 2)[cr csl]/Frontier - Elite II (1993)(GameTek)(Disk 1 of 2)[cr CSL].adf:Frontier:5:296C2
name: floor_second_and_clamp_outputs
description: Raises the second value to at least a floor passed in a register, clamps the third value to its limit pair, and stores the first input word with both results in the structure.

key: frontier - elite ii (1993)(gametek)(disk 1 of 2)[cr csl]/Frontier - Elite II (1993)(GameTek)(Disk 1 of 2)[cr CSL].adf:Frontier:5:296CC
name: clamp_third_and_store
description: Stores the first two input words unchanged in the structure and clamps the third value to its limit pair before storing it.

key: frontier - elite ii (1993)(gametek)(disk 1 of 2)[cr csl]/Frontier - Elite II (1993)(GameTek)(Disk 1 of 2)[cr CSL].adf:Frontier:5:296DE
name: floor_third_and_store
description: Raises the third value to at least a floor passed in a register, then stores the first two input words and the raised value in the structure.

key: frontier - elite ii (1993)(gametek)(disk 1 of 2)[cr csl]/Frontier - Elite II (1993)(GameTek)(Disk 1 of 2)[cr CSL].adf:Frontier:5:296E8
name: store_three_words
description: Writes three input words into consecutive positions of the structure without changing them.

key: frontier - elite ii (1993)(gametek)(disk 1 of 2)[cr csl]/Frontier - Elite II (1993)(GameTek)(Disk 1 of 2)[cr CSL].adf:Frontier:5:296F0
name: accumulate_scaled_vector_product
description: Scales a three-element vector by a normalized shift factor and three coefficients from the structure, then adds the doubled, shifted products to three 32-bit accumulators. A negative shift count sends the update into the low words with carry propagation instead.

key: frontier - elite ii (1993)(gametek)(disk 1 of 2)[cr csl]/Frontier - Elite II (1993)(GameTek)(Disk 1 of 2)[cr CSL].adf:Frontier:5:297C2
name: accumulate_scaled_vector_checked
description: Computes a scaled vector product and adds it into three accumulators. Small scale values are added with carry propagation, while large ones are added only if no signed overflow occurs, otherwise the update is discarded.

key: frontier - elite ii (1993)(gametek)(disk 1 of 2)[cr csl]/Frontier - Elite II (1993)(GameTek)(Disk 1 of 2)[cr CSL].adf:Frontier:5:2989C
name: accumulate_clamped_pair_values
description: Adds two input low words into 16-bit accumulators and stores three clamped 32-bit sums, stopping early when an overflow check fails.

key: frontier - elite ii (1993)(gametek)(disk 1 of 2)[cr csl]/Frontier - Elite II (1993)(GameTek)(Disk 1 of 2)[cr CSL].adf:Frontier:5:298B6
name: accumulate_partial_bounded_checked
description: Adds an input low word into a 16-bit accumulator, then sets one 32-bit value and adds two clamped sums into 32-bit accumulators, stopping early if an overflow check fails.

key: frontier - elite ii (1993)(gametek)(disk 1 of 2)[cr csl]/Frontier - Elite II (1993)(GameTek)(Disk 1 of 2)[cr CSL].adf:Frontier:5:298D0
name: floor_add_and_store_checked
description: Raises one input to at least a second input, adds an offset with an overflow check, and stores the result with two other inputs in the structure. Nothing is stored when the check fails.

key: frontier - elite ii (1993)(gametek)(disk 1 of 2)[cr csl]/Frontier - Elite II (1993)(GameTek)(Disk 1 of 2)[cr CSL].adf:Frontier:5:298E2
name: shift_clamp_and_accumulate
description: Shifts three input values right by a count, clamps each one to a limit read from the structure, and adds them to three 32-bit accumulators. The update is skipped if any addition would overflow.

key: frontier - elite ii (1993)(gametek)(disk 1 of 2)[cr csl]/Frontier - Elite II (1993)(GameTek)(Disk 1 of 2)[cr CSL].adf:Frontier:5:298F8
name: clamp_three_and_accumulate
description: Clamps three input values against bounds given in registers, then adds the results into three 32-bit accumulators in the structure. All accumulators are left unchanged if any addition would overflow.

key: frontier - elite ii (1993)(gametek)(disk 1 of 2)[cr csl]/Frontier - Elite II (1993)(GameTek)(Disk 1 of 2)[cr CSL].adf:Frontier:5:29904
name: accumulate_clamped_pair_checked
description: Adds the first input unchanged into one 32-bit accumulator and clamps the second and third inputs to bounds before adding them into the other two. All accumulators are left unchanged if any addition would overflow.

key: frontier - elite ii (1993)(gametek)(disk 1 of 2)[cr csl]/Frontier - Elite II (1993)(GameTek)(Disk 1 of 2)[cr CSL].adf:Frontier:5:29910
name: accumulate_clamped_pair_checked
description: Adds the first input unchanged into one 32-bit accumulator and clamps the second and third inputs to bounds before adding them into the other two. All accumulators are left unchanged if any addition would overflow.

key: frontier - elite ii (1993)(gametek)(disk 1 of 2)[cr csl]/Frontier - Elite II (1993)(GameTek)(Disk 1 of 2)[cr CSL].adf:Frontier:5:2991C
name: accumulate_two_plain_one_clamped
description: Adds two input values unchanged into two 32-bit accumulators and adds the third input, clamped to a bound from a register, into the third accumulator. Nothing is changed if any addition would overflow.

key: frontier - elite ii (1993)(gametek)(disk 1 of 2)[cr csl]/Frontier - Elite II (1993)(GameTek)(Disk 1 of 2)[cr CSL].adf:Frontier:5:29928
name: accumulate_two_plain_one_clamped
description: Adds two input values unchanged into two 32-bit accumulators and adds the third input, clamped to a bound from a register, into the third accumulator. Nothing is changed if any addition would overflow.

key: frontier - elite ii (1993)(gametek)(disk 1 of 2)[cr csl]/Frontier - Elite II (1993)(GameTek)(Disk 1 of 2)[cr CSL].adf:Frontier:5:29934
name: accumulate_three_values_checked
description: Adds three input values into three 32-bit accumulators in the structure, leaving all of them unchanged if any addition would overflow.

key: frontier - elite ii (1993)(gametek)(disk 1 of 2)[cr csl]/Frontier - Elite II (1993)(GameTek)(Disk 1 of 2)[cr CSL].adf:Frontier:5:29950
name: normalize_and_accumulate_vector
description: Returns zero when a flag byte in the structure is clear. Otherwise it derives a normalized scale from the structure's fields, scales the components and adds them into the 16-bit and 32-bit accumulators, returning the helper's result.

key: frontier - elite ii (1993)(gametek)(disk 1 of 2)[cr csl]/Frontier - Elite II (1993)(GameTek)(Disk 1 of 2)[cr CSL].adf:Frontier:5:299B6
name: accumulate_scaled_vector_arguments
description: Shifts three arguments by a computed count, scales them by a normalized factor, and adds the products into the structure's 16-bit and 32-bit accumulators. The update is skipped when a field in the structure is zero.

key: frontier - elite ii (1993)(gametek)(disk 1 of 2)[cr csl]/Frontier - Elite II (1993)(GameTek)(Disk 1 of 2)[cr CSL].adf:Frontier:5:29A62
name: scale_and_accumulate_components
description: Scales three input values by a factor derived from a multiplier and a normalization count, then shifts the products. When the computed shift is non-negative, it also updates three 16-bit low-word accumulators with carry propagation; otherwise it adds the shifted values directly to the 32-bit accumulators.

key: frontier - elite ii (1993)(gametek)(disk 1 of 2)[cr csl]/Frontier - Elite II (1993)(GameTek)(Disk 1 of 2)[cr CSL].adf:Frontier:5:29ABE
name: shift_and_accumulate_triple
description: When a count offset by sixteen is non-negative, shifts three input values right by that count, then adds them into three 32-bit accumulators.

key: frontier - elite ii (1993)(gametek)(disk 1 of 2)[cr csl]/Frontier - Elite II (1993)(GameTek)(Disk 1 of 2)[cr CSL].adf:Frontier:5:29ADE
name: add_source_fields_and_accumulate
description: Copies a flag byte from a source structure and adds six 32-bit fields of that source into the matching fields of the destination, propagating carries between each low and high pair. It then calls a helper twice and adds its split results into the accumulators.

key: frontier - elite ii (1993)(gametek)(disk 1 of 2)[cr csl]/Frontier - Elite II (1993)(GameTek)(Disk 1 of 2)[cr CSL].adf:Frontier:5:29B20
name: subtract_source_fields_with_borrow
description: Copies a flag byte into the structure and subtracts six 32-bit fields of a source structure from the matching destination fields, propagating borrows between each low and high pair. It then subtracts helper results from the accumulators and calls a helper again.

key: frontier - elite ii (1993)(gametek)(disk 1 of 2)[cr csl]/Frontier - Elite II (1993)(GameTek)(Disk 1 of 2)[cr CSL].adf:Frontier:5:29B70
name: select_lowest_cost_flag_entry
description: Scans a bit-flagged table backward and keeps the candidate with the lowest computed cost. If the chosen flag differs from the stored one, it stores the new flag and subtracts a source structure's fields from the destination with borrow, then subtracts helper results from the accumulators.

key: frontier - elite ii (1993)(gametek)(disk 1 of 2)[cr csl]/Frontier - Elite II (1993)(GameTek)(Disk 1 of 2)[cr CSL].adf:Frontier:5:29B78
name: select_best_flag_by_guard
description: Returns immediately when a guard byte in the structure is set. Otherwise it searches a flagged table for the lowest-cost candidate, then stores its flag and updates the fields and accumulators as the chosen flag requires.

key: frontier - elite ii (1993)(gametek)(disk 1 of 2)[cr csl]/Frontier - Elite II (1993)(GameTek)(Disk 1 of 2)[cr CSL].adf:Frontier:5:29C02
name: search_flag_table_and_add
description: Scans a flagged table backward for an entry whose flag matches a given byte and whose cost is under a limit. When one is found, it copies that flag and adds a source structure's fields into the destination; otherwise it stores a new flag and subtracts the fields instead.

key: frontier - elite ii (1993)(gametek)(disk 1 of 2)[cr csl]/Frontier - Elite II (1993)(GameTek)(Disk 1 of 2)[cr CSL].adf:Frontier:5:29C34
name: add_source_fields_and_accumulate
description: Copies a flag byte from a source structure and adds six 32-bit fields of that source into the destination, propagating carries between each low and high pair. It calls a helper and adds its split results into the accumulators, then calls another helper.

key: frontier - elite ii (1993)(gametek)(disk 1 of 2)[cr csl]/Frontier - Elite II (1993)(GameTek)(Disk 1 of 2)[cr CSL].adf:Frontier:5:29C3A
name: add_source_fields_and_accumulate
description: Copies a flag byte from a source structure and adds six 32-bit fields of that source into the destination, propagating carries between each low and high pair. It calls helpers before and after and adds one helper's split results into the accumulators.

key: frontier - elite ii (1993)(gametek)(disk 1 of 2)[cr csl]/Frontier - Elite II (1993)(GameTek)(Disk 1 of 2)[cr CSL].adf:Frontier:5:29C48
name: clear_status_bit_reset_flagged
description: Clears one status bit in the structure and, if it was set, scans a flag table backward. For each entry with a second bit set, it calls a helper, clears a byte, and writes a fixed sentinel value into two words of the structure.

key: frontier - elite ii (1993)(gametek)(disk 1 of 2)[cr csl]/Frontier - Elite II (1993)(GameTek)(Disk 1 of 2)[cr CSL].adf:Frontier:5:29C7A
name: select_word_quad_and_forward
description: Passes four words to a helper, taking them from fixed offsets of the structure when a flag byte is clear, or after a preliminary helper call from other offsets when the flag is set.

key: frontier - elite ii (1993)(gametek)(disk 1 of 2)[cr csl]/Frontier - Elite II (1993)(GameTek)(Disk 1 of 2)[cr CSL].adf:Frontier:5:29C92
name: copy_nine_words_to_buffer
description: Copies nine words from a source structure into a buffer, then zeroes two 32-bit slots and writes two fixed words. It calls helpers before and after the copy.

key: frontier - elite ii (1993)(gametek)(disk 1 of 2)[cr csl]/Frontier - Elite II (1993)(GameTek)(Disk 1 of 2)[cr CSL].adf:Frontier:5:29CCC
name: transform_vector_by_matrix_pair
description: Multiplies a stored three-component vector by a 3x3 matrix and writes the doubled results into the structure. When a flag byte in the source is set, it repeats the multiplication with a second matrix into a second result set. A countdown field is decremented, and a helper is called when it goes negative.

key: frontier - elite ii (1993)(gametek)(disk 1 of 2)[cr csl]/Frontier - Elite II (1993)(GameTek)(Disk 1 of 2)[cr CSL].adf:Frontier:5:29DB2
name: subtract_scale_load_table
description: Subtracts paired 64-bit values from two structures, shifts the differences right until they fit, and stores them as words. It then copies four 32-bit values from a constant table entry selected by a three-bit field of a source byte.

key: frontier - elite ii (1993)(gametek)(disk 1 of 2)[cr csl]/Frontier - Elite II (1993)(GameTek)(Disk 1 of 2)[cr CSL].adf:Frontier:5:29DBA
name: walk_chain_and_load_table
description: Walks a chain of linked structures until one has a particular bit set, then subtracts paired 64-bit values from two structures and shifts the differences right until they fit. It stores them as words and copies four 32-bit values from a constant table entry selected by a three-bit field of a source byte.

key: frontier - elite ii (1993)(gametek)(disk 1 of 2)[cr csl]/Frontier - Elite II (1993)(GameTek)(Disk 1 of 2)[cr CSL].adf:Frontier:5:29E5A
name: load_table_entry_into_buffer
description: Stores three word inputs into the structure's vector slots after a helper call, then copies four 32-bit values from a constant table entry selected by a three-bit field of a source byte.

key: frontier - elite ii (1993)(gametek)(disk 1 of 2)[cr csl]/Frontier - Elite II (1993)(GameTek)(Disk 1 of 2)[cr CSL].adf:Frontier:5:29EFA
name: service_flagged_table_entries
description: Sets a status bit and scans a flag table backward for entries with a particular bit set. Each matching entry has its flag bits updated, and depending on its own flags it receives a fixed value, helper calls, or a sentinel pair when a stored byte matches.

key: frontier - elite ii (1993)(gametek)(disk 1 of 2)[cr csl]/Frontier - Elite II (1993)(GameTek)(Disk 1 of 2)[cr CSL].adf:Frontier:5:29FE8
name: service_flagged_entry_chain
description: Scans a flag table backward for entries with a particular bit set and services each one. Depending on the entry's flags it writes a sentinel pair, sets a fixed value and calls helpers, or continues scanning.

key: frontier - elite ii (1993)(gametek)(disk 1 of 2)[cr csl]/Frontier - Elite II (1993)(GameTek)(Disk 1 of 2)[cr CSL].adf:Frontier:5:2A00E
name: write_sentinel_and_service_entries
description: Writes a sentinel pair into the current entry, then scans a flag table backward for entries with a particular bit set. Each matching entry is serviced through helper calls and, when its flags are set, receives a fixed value before scanning resumes.

key: frontier - elite ii (1993)(gametek)(disk 1 of 2)[cr csl]/Frontier - Elite II (1993)(GameTek)(Disk 1 of 2)[cr CSL].adf:Frontier:5:2A018
name: scan_flagged_entries_with_counter
description: Calls a helper, then scans a flag table backward for entries with a particular bit set. For each one, it stores a saved value into the entry when a counter field is zero, otherwise it decrements that counter.

key: frontier - elite ii (1993)(gametek)(disk 1 of 2)[cr csl]/Frontier - Elite II (1993)(GameTek)(Disk 1 of 2)[cr CSL].adf:Frontier:5:2A046
name: scan_flags_with_restart_counter
description: Stores a word into the structure and calls a helper, then scans a flag table backward for entries with a particular bit set. For each match it calls a helper; when a counter field is zero the store step restarts, otherwise the counter is decremented.

key: frontier - elite ii (1993)(gametek)(disk 1 of 2)[cr csl]/Frontier - Elite II (1993)(GameTek)(Disk 1 of 2)[cr CSL].adf:Frontier:5:2A062
name: add_table_scaled_offsets
description: Selects a 16-bit component pair from a table according to status bits, negating the coefficients when a bit is set, and multiplies the pair by coefficients from the structure. The products, shifted right by twelve, are added to six 32-bit fields with carry propagation, and a timer field is set before a helper call.

key: frontier - elite ii (1993)(gametek)(disk 1 of 2)[cr csl]/Frontier - Elite II (1993)(GameTek)(Disk 1 of 2)[cr CSL].adf:Frontier:5:2A09A
name: add_table_scaled_offsets
description: Chooses a 16-bit component pair from a table by status bits, negating the coefficients when a bit is set, then multiplies it with coefficients from the structure. The products, shifted right by twelve, are added to six 32-bit fields with carry propagation, and a timer field is set before a helper call.

key: frontier - elite ii (1993)(gametek)(disk 1 of 2)[cr csl]/Frontier - Elite II (1993)(GameTek)(Disk 1 of 2)[cr CSL].adf:Frontier:5:2A14C
name: add_scaled_offsets_to_fields
description: Multiplies a 16-bit component pair selected by a status bit with coefficients from the structure. The products, shifted right by twelve, are added to six 32-bit fields with carry propagation, and a timer field is set before a helper call.

key: frontier - elite ii (1993)(gametek)(disk 1 of 2)[cr csl]/Frontier - Elite II (1993)(GameTek)(Disk 1 of 2)[cr CSL].adf:Frontier:5:2A1C4
name: clear_counter_byte
description: Sets one byte field of the structure to zero and changes nothing else.

key: frontier - elite ii (1993)(gametek)(disk 1 of 2)[cr csl]/Frontier - Elite II (1993)(GameTek)(Disk 1 of 2)[cr CSL].adf:Frontier:5:2A1CA
name: reset_word_and_scan_entries
description: Clears a 16-bit field of the structure, then scans a byte table backward. For each nonzero entry without a particular bit set, it calls two helpers.

key: frontier - elite ii (1993)(gametek)(disk 1 of 2)[cr csl]/Frontier - Elite II (1993)(GameTek)(Disk 1 of 2)[cr CSL].adf:Frontier:5:2A1D2
name: iterate_and_call_handler
description: Scans a byte table backward and, for each nonzero entry without a particular bit set, calls a helper and then an indirect handler.

key: frontier - elite ii (1993)(gametek)(disk 1 of 2)[cr csl]/Frontier - Elite II (1993)(GameTek)(Disk 1 of 2)[cr CSL].adf:Frontier:5:2A1F6
name: check_bounds_and_call
description: Scans a flag table backward for entries with a particular bit set. For each one it calls a helper, and when two 16-bit fields fall within fixed ranges it calls an indirect handler.

key: frontier - elite ii (1993)(gametek)(disk 1 of 2)[cr csl]/Frontier - Elite II (1993)(GameTek)(Disk 1 of 2)[cr CSL].adf:Frontier:5:2A236
name: decrement_counter_and_dispatch
description: Scans a flag table backward for entries with bit zero set. For each one it calls a helper; when a counter byte reaches zero it reloads the counter from a stored value and calls a handler chosen from a table by a byte field, otherwise it decrements the counter.

key: frontier - elite ii (1993)(gametek)(disk 1 of 2)[cr csl]/Frontier - Elite II (1993)(GameTek)(Disk 1 of 2)[cr CSL].adf:Frontier:5:2A286
name: clear_flag_and_dispatch_entries
description: Clears one flag bit in a global byte, then scans a flag table backward for entries with a second bit set. For each match it calls a helper and, when a field of the entry is nonzero, calls a handler selected from a table by that field.

key: frontier - elite ii (1993)(gametek)(disk 1 of 2)[cr csl]/Frontier - Elite II (1993)(GameTek)(Disk 1 of 2)[cr CSL].adf:Frontier:5:2A2C8
name: write_byte_to_indirect
description: Writes the low byte of an input value to an address formed from a stored base pointer plus a byte field of the structure.

key: frontier - elite ii (1993)(gametek)(disk 1 of 2)[cr csl]/Frontier - Elite II (1993)(GameTek)(Disk 1 of 2)[cr CSL].adf:Frontier:5:2A2DC
name: copy_template_into_flagged_slot
description: Scans a flag table backward for an entry with a particular bit set, updates a counter and that entry's flag byte, then copies a large template structure from the input into the slot's data. The pseudo-code is cut off before the routine ends, so the remaining field setup is not described.

key: frontier - elite ii (1993)(gametek)(disk 1 of 2)[cr csl]/Frontier - Elite II (1993)(GameTek)(Disk 1 of 2)[cr CSL].adf:Frontier:5:2A2FC
name: copy_template_into_unflagged_slot
description: Scans a flag table backward for an entry without a particular bit set, and when its index is above a threshold, updates a counter and the entry's flag byte. It then copies a large template structure from the input into that slot's data; the pseudo-code is cut off before the routine ends.

key: frontier - elite ii (1993)(gametek)(disk 1 of 2)[cr csl]/Frontier - Elite II (1993)(GameTek)(Disk 1 of 2)[cr CSL].adf:Frontier:5:2A324
name: copy_template_into_indexed_slot
description: For a nonzero slot index, updates a counter and the slot's flag byte, then copies a large template structure from the input into that slot's data. It also derives packed fields from table entries looked up by the slot index, and the pseudo-code is cut off before the routine ends.

key: frontier - elite ii (1993)(gametek)(disk 1 of 2)[cr csl]/Frontier - Elite II (1993)(GameTek)(Disk 1 of 2)[cr CSL].adf:Frontier:5:2A330
name: copy_block_and_init_slot
description: Copies a fixed-size block of longwords and one word from the source to the destination unless both are the same location. When an index is nonzero it also sets fields from indexed table entries, and the listing is cut off after that point.

key: frontier - elite ii (1993)(gametek)(disk 1 of 2)[cr csl]/Frontier - Elite II (1993)(GameTek)(Disk 1 of 2)[cr CSL].adf:Frontier:5:2A4F2
name: copy_template_to_zero_slot
description: Looks for an entry whose flag byte is zero, and if none qualifies, for one without a particular bit set above a threshold index. It then updates a counter and the flag byte and copies a large template structure into the slot; table-derived fields are set when the index is nonzero, and the listing is cut off.

key: frontier - elite ii (1993)(gametek)(disk 1 of 2)[cr csl]/Frontier - Elite II (1993)(GameTek)(Disk 1 of 2)[cr CSL].adf:Frontier:5:2A512
name: copy_template_to_bit_slot
description: Looks for an entry whose flag byte is zero, and if none qualifies, for one with a particular bit set. It then updates a counter and the flag byte and copies a large template structure into the slot; table-derived fields are set when the index is nonzero, and the listing is cut off.

key: frontier - elite ii (1993)(gametek)(disk 1 of 2)[cr csl]/Frontier - Elite II (1993)(GameTek)(Disk 1 of 2)[cr CSL].adf:Frontier:5:2A548
name: return_immediately
description: Returns straight away without touching any data or hardware. It is an empty stub.

key: frontier - elite ii (1993)(gametek)(disk 1 of 2)[cr csl]/Frontier - Elite II (1993)(GameTek)(Disk 1 of 2)[cr CSL].adf:Frontier:5:2A556
name: return_immediately
description: Returns straight away without touching any data or hardware. It is an empty stub.

name: return_immediately
description: Returns straight away without touching any data or hardware. It is an empty stub.

name: return_immediately
description: Returns straight away without touching any data or hardware. It is an empty stub.

name: return_immediately
description: Returns straight away without touching any data or hardware. It is an empty stub.

key: frontier - elite ii (1993)(gametek)(disk 1 of 2)[cr csl]/Frontier - Elite II (1993)(GameTek)(Disk 1 of 2)[cr CSL].adf:Frontier:5:2A662
name: zero_flag_table_entries
description: Stores a pointer to a byte table in the structure and zeroes its entries from the top index downward.

key: frontier - elite ii (1993)(gametek)(disk 1 of 2)[cr csl]/Frontier - Elite II (1993)(GameTek)(Disk 1 of 2)[cr CSL].adf:Frontier:5:2A674
name: reset_counter_and_clear_flagged
description: Resets a 16-bit counter in the structure to zero, then clears every table entry that has a particular bit set. The table is located through a pointer stored in the structure.

key: frontier - elite ii (1993)(gametek)(disk 1 of 2)[cr csl]/Frontier - Elite II (1993)(GameTek)(Disk 1 of 2)[cr CSL].adf:Frontier:5:2A696
name: clear_indexed_flag_entry
description: Looks up a flag entry by a byte field of the structure. It decrements a counter when that entry has a particular bit set, then clears the entry.

key: frontier - elite ii (1993)(gametek)(disk 1 of 2)[cr csl]/Frontier - Elite II (1993)(GameTek)(Disk 1 of 2)[cr CSL].adf:Frontier:5:2A6BA
name: call_helper_and_return
description: Calls a helper routine and returns, doing no other work.

key: frontier - elite ii (1993)(gametek)(disk 1 of 2)[cr csl]/Frontier - Elite II (1993)(GameTek)(Disk 1 of 2)[cr CSL].adf:Frontier:5:2A6C4
name: clear_flag_after_slot_callbacks
description: Looks up a flag entry by a byte field of the structure. If its bit is clear, it calls an indirect method on each enabled slot of a fixed-stride list and then clears the entry; otherwise it decrements a counter and clears the entry.

key: frontier - elite ii (1993)(gametek)(disk 1 of 2)[cr csl]/Frontier - Elite II (1993)(GameTek)(Disk 1 of 2)[cr CSL].adf:Frontier:5:2A710
name: countdown_and_dispatch_update
description: Calls an indirect method on each enabled slot, then either returns early after a helper call or subtracts a 16-bit input from a countdown field. When that field underflows, it adds the accumulated value to a second field and dispatches through several indirect calls and helpers. The pseudo-code is cut off before the routine ends.

key: frontier - elite ii (1993)(gametek)(disk 1 of 2)[cr csl]/Frontier - Elite II (1993)(GameTek)(Disk 1 of 2)[cr CSL].adf:Frontier:5:2A7CE
name: call_indirect_and_return_one
description: Calls an indirect method through a table, then returns a fixed result of one together with an input value.

key: frontier - elite ii (1993)(gametek)(disk 1 of 2)[cr csl]/Frontier - Elite II (1993)(GameTek)(Disk 1 of 2)[cr CSL].adf:Frontier:5:2A7E6
name: set_status_bit_and_notify
description: Calls an indirect method, sets bit zero of a status byte in the structure, and calls a second indirect method when a field equals minus one. It returns a fixed value of one.

key: frontier - elite ii (1993)(gametek)(disk 1 of 2)[cr csl]/Frontier - Elite II (1993)(GameTek)(Disk 1 of 2)[cr CSL].adf:Frontier:5:2A800
name: dispatch_timed_event_update
description: Adds a table-derived value to an accumulator and calls an indirect method when its high word changes. It then sets several status fields and calls helpers, adjusts a counter, runs loops of indirect calls depending on table values, and returns zero.

key: frontier - elite ii (1993)(gametek)(disk 1 of 2)[cr csl]/Frontier - Elite II (1993)(GameTek)(Disk 1 of 2)[cr CSL].adf:Frontier:5:2A99A
name: return_stack_argument
description: Returns the first value passed on the stack without changing it.

key: frontier - elite ii (1993)(gametek)(disk 1 of 2)[cr csl]/Frontier - Elite II (1993)(GameTek)(Disk 1 of 2)[cr CSL].adf:Frontier:5:2A9A0
name: init_fields_and_accumulate_results
description: Sets several status fields and a 16-bit value, makes indirect calls, and adds three values shifted from the results into the structure's accumulators. It returns the result of the final indirect call.

key: frontier - elite ii (1993)(gametek)(disk 1 of 2)[cr csl]/Frontier - Elite II (1993)(GameTek)(Disk 1 of 2)[cr CSL].adf:Frontier:5:2AA0A
name: bin_value_and_accumulate_weight
description: Calls an indirect method and sorts a 16-bit result into fixed ranges. Each range adds a weight from a table to totals in the structure or clears a stored slot, with some updates gated by a status byte, and it returns one.

key: frontier - elite ii (1993)(gametek)(disk 1 of 2)[cr csl]/Frontier - Elite II (1993)(GameTek)(Disk 1 of 2)[cr CSL].adf:Frontier:5:2AA5A
name: move_first_matching_bit
description: Repeatedly calls an indirect method to pick a bit index until one is set in a 32-bit mask in the structure. It then moves that bit from the first mask into a second mask.

key: frontier - elite ii (1993)(gametek)(disk 1 of 2)[cr csl]/Frontier - Elite II (1993)(GameTek)(Disk 1 of 2)[cr CSL].adf:Frontier:5:2AAAC
name: bin_input_add_weight
description: Sorts a 16-bit input into fixed ranges. Each range adds a weight from a table to totals in the structure or clears a stored slot, with some updates gated by a status byte, and it returns one.

key: frontier - elite ii (1993)(gametek)(disk 1 of 2)[cr csl]/Frontier - Elite II (1993)(GameTek)(Disk 1 of 2)[cr CSL].adf:Frontier:5:2AAE6
name: add_table_weight_to_totals
description: Clears a saved status byte and a 32-bit field in the structure, then adds a table weight to three totals when a status byte is set. It then calls an indirect method and a helper.

key: frontier - elite ii (1993)(gametek)(disk 1 of 2)[cr csl]/Frontier - Elite II (1993)(GameTek)(Disk 1 of 2)[cr CSL].adf:Frontier:5:2AB1A
name: add_adjusted_weight_to_totals
description: When a saved byte is nonzero, sets it to one and, if a status byte is set, adds a table weight reduced by four to three totals. It then calls an indirect method and a helper, and returns one.

key: frontier - elite ii (1993)(gametek)(disk 1 of 2)[cr csl]/Frontier - Elite II (1993)(GameTek)(Disk 1 of 2)[cr CSL].adf:Frontier:5:2AB50
name: decrement_bin_for_input
description: Compares a 16-bit input with a limit and, when it is below, walks a table of cumulative values to find its bin. It decrements that bin's count and increments a total, and calls an indirect method when a status byte is set.

key: frontier - elite ii (1993)(gametek)(disk 1 of 2)[cr csl]/Frontier - Elite II (1993)(GameTek)(Disk 1 of 2)[cr CSL].adf:Frontier:5:2AB84
name: charge_budget_and_update_fields
description: Moves a 16-bit field toward a target at a rate, decrements status counters, and sums absolute values of three components scaled by a table entry. It subtracts that cost from a budget field; when the budget runs out it may adjust counters, call an indirect method, and clear three fields, otherwise it returns the cost.

key: frontier - elite ii (1993)(gametek)(disk 1 of 2)[cr csl]/Frontier - Elite II (1993)(GameTek)(Disk 1 of 2)[cr CSL].adf:Frontier:5:2AC6E
name: charge_budget_and_clear_fields
description: Subtracts an input cost from a budget field and returns early while budget remains. When the budget is exhausted it either refills it by a fixed step after decrementing a counter, or calls an indirect method, and then clears three fields.

key: frontier - elite ii (1993)(gametek)(disk 1 of 2)[cr csl]/Frontier - Elite II (1993)(GameTek)(Disk 1 of 2)[cr CSL].adf:Frontier:5:2ACA8
name: refill_budget_or_clear_fields
description: When a counter is nonzero, decrements it and adds a fixed step to a budget field. Otherwise it sets a status bit, calls an indirect method if the bit was clear, and clears three fields.

key: frontier - elite ii (1993)(gametek)(disk 1 of 2)[cr csl]/Frontier - Elite II (1993)(GameTek)(Disk 1 of 2)[cr CSL].adf:Frontier:5:2ACB8
name: decrement_budget_counter_or_clear
description: When a counter byte is nonzero, decrements it and adds a fixed step to a budget field. Otherwise it clears three fields in the structure.

key: frontier - elite ii (1993)(gametek)(disk 1 of 2)[cr csl]/Frontier - Elite II (1993)(GameTek)(Disk 1 of 2)[cr CSL].adf:Frontier:5:2ACD0
name: set_status_and_clear_fields
description: Sets bit zero of a status byte in the global block and calls an indirect method if the bit was previously clear. It then clears three 32-bit fields in the structure.

key: frontier - elite ii (1993)(gametek)(disk 1 of 2)[cr csl]/Frontier - Elite II (1993)(GameTek)(Disk 1 of 2)[cr CSL].adf:Frontier:5:2AD02
name: countdown_timer_and_reload
description: Subtracts an input amount from a 32-bit timer and returns while it stays positive. On expiry it reloads the timer with a fixed interval, decrements two counters, and calls helpers, then may add a table weight to totals, clear a saved byte, and call an indirect method.

key: frontier - elite ii (1993)(gametek)(disk 1 of 2)[cr csl]/Frontier - Elite II (1993)(GameTek)(Disk 1 of 2)[cr CSL].adf:Frontier:5:2AD0A
name: reload_timer_and_decrement_counters
description: Reloads a 32-bit timer with a fixed interval, decrements two counters, and calls helpers. It then may add a table weight to totals, clear a saved byte, and call an indirect method.

key: frontier - elite ii (1993)(gametek)(disk 1 of 2)[cr csl]/Frontier - Elite II (1993)(GameTek)(Disk 1 of 2)[cr CSL].adf:Frontier:5:2AD42
name: add_saved_weight_and_clear
description: When a saved byte is nonzero, clears it and clears a 32-bit field in the structure. It adds a table weight to three totals and then calls an indirect method.

key: frontier - elite ii (1993)(gametek)(disk 1 of 2)[cr csl]/Frontier - Elite II (1993)(GameTek)(Disk 1 of 2)[cr CSL].adf:Frontier:5:2AD76
name: add_saved_weight_over_limit
description: Calls a helper and compares its low byte with a limit field. When the limit is exceeded and a saved byte is nonzero, it clears the saved byte and a field, adds a table weight to three totals, and calls an indirect method.

key: frontier - elite ii (1993)(gametek)(disk 1 of 2)[cr csl]/Frontier - Elite II (1993)(GameTek)(Disk 1 of 2)[cr CSL].adf:Frontier:5:2AD7C
name: add_saved_weight_on_limit
description: Calls a helper and, when the zero condition is set, compares a helper's low byte with a limit field. When the limit is exceeded and a saved byte is nonzero, it clears the saved byte and a field, adds a table weight to totals, and calls an indirect method.

key: frontier - elite ii (1993)(gametek)(disk 1 of 2)[cr csl]/Frontier - Elite II (1993)(GameTek)(Disk 1 of 2)[cr CSL].adf:Frontier:6:0000
name: store_word_and_notify_previous
description: Stores a 16-bit input in a field of the structure. When the previous value was nonzero, it calls an indirect method on the object that the old value selects from a table.

key: frontier - elite ii (1993)(gametek)(disk 1 of 2)[cr csl]/Frontier - Elite II (1993)(GameTek)(Disk 1 of 2)[cr CSL].adf:Frontier:6:0014
name: store_word_in_field
description: Stores a 16-bit input into a field of the structure.

key: frontier - elite ii (1993)(gametek)(disk 1 of 2)[cr csl]/Frontier - Elite II (1993)(GameTek)(Disk 1 of 2)[cr CSL].adf:Frontier:6:001A
name: lookup_piecewise_table_value
description: Maps a 32-bit input to a 16-bit output through a table lookup. The table index and right shift are chosen by the range the input falls into, with separate branches for small, medium and large inputs.

key: frontier - elite ii (1993)(gametek)(disk 1 of 2)[cr csl]/Frontier - Elite II (1993)(GameTek)(Disk 1 of 2)[cr CSL].adf:Frontier:6:0390
name: initialize_slots_and_run_each
description: Clears a counter, writes fixed constants and default pointers into the structure, and fills a fixed-stride list with slot pointers. It then calls a method of each slot entry in turn.

key: frontier - elite ii (1993)(gametek)(disk 1 of 2)[cr csl]/Frontier - Elite II (1993)(GameTek)(Disk 1 of 2)[cr CSL].adf:Frontier:6:0464
name: run_slot_passes_until_five
description: When a 16-bit input is below a threshold, writes two fixed constants. It sets several fields to defaults, then repeatedly calls a method of each slot entry while a counter started from the input stays below five.

key: frontier - elite ii (1993)(gametek)(disk 1 of 2)[cr csl]/Frontier - Elite II (1993)(GameTek)(Disk 1 of 2)[cr CSL].adf:Frontier:6:04CC
name: advance_slots_and_dispatch_flags
description: Calls a method on each enabled slot and compares a stored tick value with a counter. When the difference reaches a fixed period, it passes the whole number of periods to slots with a flag bit set and advances the stored tick value. It then dispatches a handler for each flagged table entry.

key: frontier - elite ii (1993)(gametek)(disk 1 of 2)[cr csl]/Frontier - Elite II (1993)(GameTek)(Disk 1 of 2)[cr CSL].adf:Frontier:6:0548
name: call_method_on_active_slots
description: Walks the fixed-stride slot list and calls a method on each slot whose active byte is nonzero.

key: frontier - elite ii (1993)(gametek)(disk 1 of 2)[cr csl]/Frontier - Elite II (1993)(GameTek)(Disk 1 of 2)[cr CSL].adf:Frontier:6:056A
name: read_code_when_flag_clear
description: Calls an indirect method to read a code when a flag bit is clear. A slot search follows, but its guard is always false at that point, so the routine effectively only makes the read call.

key: frontier - elite ii (1993)(gametek)(disk 1 of 2)[cr csl]/Frontier - Elite II (1993)(GameTek)(Disk 1 of 2)[cr CSL].adf:Frontier:6:05A2
name: notify_slots_for_code_category
description: Maps a 16-bit code to one of several category bits and calls a method on each slot whose flag byte has that bit set.

key: frontier - elite ii (1993)(gametek)(disk 1 of 2)[cr csl]/Frontier - Elite II (1993)(GameTek)(Disk 1 of 2)[cr CSL].adf:Frontier:6:05EE
name: mix_seed_state_words
description: Updates a pair of 32-bit state words in the structure with a mixing step. One word is xored with a constant, rotated and added to the other, and the other word is shifted and rotated.

key: frontier - elite ii (1993)(gametek)(disk 1 of 2)[cr csl]/Frontier - Elite II (1993)(GameTek)(Disk 1 of 2)[cr CSL].adf:Frontier:6:060A
name: advance_state_and_scale_input
description: Updates two 32-bit state words in the structure with a rotate-and-add step, then multiplies the upper half of the new state by the low word of the input. It returns the product as a 64-bit result.

key: frontier - elite ii (1993)(gametek)(disk 1 of 2)[cr csl]/Frontier - Elite II (1993)(GameTek)(Disk 1 of 2)[cr CSL].adf:Frontier:6:062C
name: scale_input_by_rotate_sum
description: Computes a rotate-and-add sum from two inputs, takes its upper half, and multiplies it by the low word of another input. It returns the product with its halves swapped.

key: frontier - elite ii (1993)(gametek)(disk 1 of 2)[cr csl]/Frontier - Elite II (1993)(GameTek)(Disk 1 of 2)[cr CSL].adf:Frontier:6:063C
name: negate_helper_result_pair
description: Calls a helper that returns a 64-bit value and returns its two's-complement negation, adjusting the high word for the borrow.

key: frontier - elite ii (1993)(gametek)(disk 1 of 2)[cr csl]/Frontier - Elite II (1993)(GameTek)(Disk 1 of 2)[cr CSL].adf:Frontier:6:0648
name: subtract_and_scale_wide
description: Subtracts two 64-bit inputs and, when the difference is non-negative, multiplies it by a 32-bit factor with carries and returns a shifted 64-bit result. Otherwise it returns the negated result of a helper call.

key: frontier - elite ii (1993)(gametek)(disk 1 of 2)[cr csl]/Frontier - Elite II (1993)(GameTek)(Disk 1 of 2)[cr CSL].adf:Frontier:6:064E
name: multiply_fixed_point_wide
description: Multiplies two 32-bit register values using 16-bit partial products with carries, adds a third term, and returns a 64-bit product with its halves shifted into place.

key: frontier - elite ii (1993)(gametek)(disk 1 of 2)[cr csl]/Frontier - Elite II (1993)(GameTek)(Disk 1 of 2)[cr CSL].adf:Frontier:6:06AE
name: scale_and_shift_vector_fields
description: Stores the difference of two helper results in the structure, then scales three products by a count and shifts them into six 32-bit fields. A small count shifts right with carry bits, while a large count shifts left.

key: frontier - elite ii (1993)(gametek)(disk 1 of 2)[cr csl]/Frontier - Elite II (1993)(GameTek)(Disk 1 of 2)[cr CSL].adf:Frontier:6:072E
name: store_inputs_and_shift_fields
description: Stores three inputs and three values shifted left by one less than a count into six 32-bit fields of the structure.

key: frontier - elite ii (1993)(gametek)(disk 1 of 2)[cr csl]/Frontier - Elite II (1993)(GameTek)(Disk 1 of 2)[cr CSL].adf:Frontier:6:0738
name: multiply_components_and_accumulate
description: Multiplies three stored 16-bit components by a scaled input, shifts the products by a count, and adds them into six 32-bit fields of the structure with carry propagation.

key: frontier - elite ii (1993)(gametek)(disk 1 of 2)[cr csl]/Frontier - Elite II (1993)(GameTek)(Disk 1 of 2)[cr CSL].adf:Frontier:6:0796
name: shift_wide_by_bit_count
description: Counts how many right shifts reduce a register value to zero, calls a helper for a 64-bit value, and doubles that value the counted number of times.

key: frontier - elite ii (1993)(gametek)(disk 1 of 2)[cr csl]/Frontier - Elite II (1993)(GameTek)(Disk 1 of 2)[cr CSL].adf:Frontier:6:07BE
name: shift_wide_by_normalize
description: Shifts a register value right until it is at most a 15-bit limit and counts the shifts. It then calls a helper for a 64-bit value and doubles it that many times.

key: frontier - elite ii (1993)(gametek)(disk 1 of 2)[cr csl]/Frontier - Elite II (1993)(GameTek)(Disk 1 of 2)[cr CSL].adf:Frontier:6:07D2
name: negate_both_halves_result
description: Calls a helper for a 64-bit value and returns its negation by negating both 32-bit halves separately.

key: frontier - elite ii (1993)(gametek)(disk 1 of 2)[cr csl]/Frontier - Elite II (1993)(GameTek)(Disk 1 of 2)[cr CSL].adf:Frontier:6:07E6
name: multiply_wide_by_scaled_factor
description: Returns the negated result of a helper when a high input is negative. Otherwise it multiplies a stored 64-bit value by a scaled version of an input, and for large scaled values it shifts right and doubles a helper's 64-bit result the counted number of times.

key: frontier - elite ii (1993)(gametek)(disk 1 of 2)[cr csl]/Frontier - Elite II (1993)(GameTek)(Disk 1 of 2)[cr CSL].adf:Frontier:6:07EA
name: multiply_wide_when_zero_flag
description: When the zero condition is set, multiplies a stored 64-bit value by a scaled input. Otherwise it counts shifts of an input and doubles a helper's 64-bit result that many times.

key: frontier - elite ii (1993)(gametek)(disk 1 of 2)[cr csl]/Frontier - Elite II (1993)(GameTek)(Disk 1 of 2)[cr CSL].adf:Frontier:6:07EC
name: multiply_wide_scaled_or_normalize
description: Multiplies a stored 64-bit value by a scaled input, or, when the scaled input exceeds a 15-bit limit, shifts it right, counts the shifts and doubles a helper's 64-bit result that many times.

key: frontier - elite ii (1993)(gametek)(disk 1 of 2)[cr csl]/Frontier - Elite II (1993)(GameTek)(Disk 1 of 2)[cr CSL].adf:Frontier:6:07F6
name: multiply_wide_by_word
description: Multiplies a 64-bit value held in two registers by a 16-bit factor and returns the 64-bit product with its partial results shifted into place.

key: frontier - elite ii (1993)(gametek)(disk 1 of 2)[cr csl]/Frontier - Elite II (1993)(GameTek)(Disk 1 of 2)[cr CSL].adf:Frontier:6:0854
name: accumulate_wide_result_into_fields
description: Adds a helper's 64-bit result and two values read from the structure into six 32-bit fields, propagating carries between each pair.

key: frontier - elite ii (1993)(gametek)(disk 1 of 2)[cr csl]/Frontier - Elite II (1993)(GameTek)(Disk 1 of 2)[cr CSL].adf:Frontier:6:0882
name: call_two_helpers
description: Calls two helper routines in sequence and returns.

key: frontier - elite ii (1993)(gametek)(disk 1 of 2)[cr csl]/Frontier - Elite II (1993)(GameTek)(Disk 1 of 2)[cr CSL].adf:Frontier:6:08A8
name: call_two_helpers
description: Calls two helper routines in sequence and returns.

key: frontier - elite ii (1993)(gametek)(disk 1 of 2)[cr csl]/Frontier - Elite II (1993)(GameTek)(Disk 1 of 2)[cr CSL].adf:Frontier:6:08CE
name: call_two_helpers
description: Calls two helper routines in sequence and returns.

key: frontier - elite ii (1993)(gametek)(disk 1 of 2)[cr csl]/Frontier - Elite II (1993)(GameTek)(Disk 1 of 2)[cr CSL].adf:Frontier:6:08F4
name: read_table_word_at_index
description: Returns a 16-bit word from a table whose base pointer is stored in the structure, indexed by the 16-bit input.

key: frontier - elite ii (1993)(gametek)(disk 1 of 2)[cr csl]/Frontier - Elite II (1993)(GameTek)(Disk 1 of 2)[cr CSL].adf:Frontier:6:0906
name: store_table_base_pointers
description: Stores two 32-bit input pointers into the structure's table pointer fields.

key: frontier - elite ii (1993)(gametek)(disk 1 of 2)[cr csl]/Frontier - Elite II (1993)(GameTek)(Disk 1 of 2)[cr CSL].adf:Frontier:6:0910
name: set_default_table_pointers
description: Sets two table pointer fields in the structure to a fixed global data block.

key: frontier - elite ii (1993)(gametek)(disk 1 of 2)[cr csl]/Frontier - Elite II (1993)(GameTek)(Disk 1 of 2)[cr CSL].adf:Frontier:6:0922
name: allocate_index_slot_once
description: If the byte at the given index is zero and a global counter is below a fixed limit, stores the counter in that byte. It writes the index and counter as a word into the global block and advances the counter by four.

key: frontier - elite ii (1993)(gametek)(disk 1 of 2)[cr csl]/Frontier - Elite II (1993)(GameTek)(Disk 1 of 2)[cr CSL].adf:Frontier:6:093C
name: allocate_index_slot_with_result
description: If a global counter is below a fixed limit, stores the counter into the byte at a structure offset given by the input. It writes the input and counter as a word into the global block, advances the counter by four, and returns that word; otherwise it returns zero.

key: frontier - elite ii (1993)(gametek)(disk 1 of 2)[cr csl]/Frontier - Elite II (1993)(GameTek)(Disk 1 of 2)[cr CSL].adf:Frontier:6:094E
name: append_index_entry_and_advance
description: Writes an input byte into a table at a given index and writes the index and value as a word at the counter's position. It then advances that counter by four.

key: frontier - elite ii (1993)(gametek)(disk 1 of 2)[cr csl]/Frontier - Elite II (1993)(GameTek)(Disk 1 of 2)[cr CSL].adf:Frontier:6:0962
name: return_immediately
description: Returns straight away without touching any data or hardware. It is an empty stub.

key: frontier - elite ii (1993)(gametek)(disk 1 of 2)[cr csl]/Frontier - Elite II (1993)(GameTek)(Disk 1 of 2)[cr CSL].adf:Frontier:6:096E
name: check_bounds_then_call_helper
description: Checks two pairs of 16-bit values against fixed upper limits. When a pair is out of range it calls a helper and returns early if the adjusted values are still out of range; otherwise it calls a helper.

key: frontier - elite ii (1993)(gametek)(disk 1 of 2)[cr csl]/Frontier - Elite II (1993)(GameTek)(Disk 1 of 2)[cr CSL].adf:Frontier:6:0986
name: call_helper_and_return
description: Calls a helper routine and returns, doing no other work.

key: frontier - elite ii (1993)(gametek)(disk 1 of 2)[cr csl]/Frontier - Elite II (1993)(GameTek)(Disk 1 of 2)[cr CSL].adf:Frontier:6:0996
name: check_bounds_then_call_helper
description: Checks two pairs of 16-bit values against fixed upper limits, returning early when the first pair is out of range. When the second pair is out of range it calls a helper and returns if the adjusted values are still out of range; otherwise it calls a helper.

key: frontier - elite ii (1993)(gametek)(disk 1 of 2)[cr csl]/Frontier - Elite II (1993)(GameTek)(Disk 1 of 2)[cr CSL].adf:Frontier:6:09AA
name: check_bounds_then_call_once
description: Returns early when a 16-bit value exceeds a fixed limit or a second value exceeds another limit. Otherwise it calls a helper.

key: frontier - elite ii (1993)(gametek)(disk 1 of 2)[cr csl]/Frontier - Elite II (1993)(GameTek)(Disk 1 of 2)[cr CSL].adf:Frontier:6:09C2
name: set_flags_notify_when_bit
description: Reads a 32-bit field and returns it. When a high bit is set it sets two global status bits, writes a counter field, adjusts two flag bits in the structure, and calls a helper; the same update runs when a lower bit is set, without the extra global bit.

key: frontier - elite ii (1993)(gametek)(disk 1 of 2)[cr csl]/Frontier - Elite II (1993)(GameTek)(Disk 1 of 2)[cr CSL].adf:Frontier:6:09D4
name: set_status_flags_and_notify
description: Sets two global status bits and a structure counter field, adjusts two flag bits in the structure, and calls a helper. It returns its two register inputs unchanged.

key: frontier - elite ii (1993)(gametek)(disk 1 of 2)[cr csl]/Frontier - Elite II (1993)(GameTek)(Disk 1 of 2)[cr CSL].adf:Frontier:6:0A06
name: set_flag_and_notify_single
description: Sets one global status bit and a structure counter field, adjusts two flag bits in the structure, and calls a helper. It returns its two register inputs unchanged.

key: frontier - elite ii (1993)(gametek)(disk 1 of 2)[cr csl]/Frontier - Elite II (1993)(GameTek)(Disk 1 of 2)[cr CSL].adf:Frontier:6:0A32
name: clear_flag_add_counter
description: When a bit in a structure field is set, clears it and adds four to a counter in either the global block or the structure, depending on a status byte. It then sets status flags, calls two helpers, and sets a global status bit.

key: frontier - elite ii (1993)(gametek)(disk 1 of 2)[cr csl]/Frontier - Elite II (1993)(GameTek)(Disk 1 of 2)[cr CSL].adf:Frontier:6:0A3E
name: store_field_and_notify_counter
description: Stores a 32-bit input into a structure field, adds four to a counter in the global block or the structure depending on a status byte, sets status flags, and calls two helpers. A global status bit is set last.

key: frontier - elite ii (1993)(gametek)(disk 1 of 2)[cr csl]/Frontier - Elite II (1993)(GameTek)(Disk 1 of 2)[cr CSL].adf:Frontier:6:0A50
name: increment_field_and_notify
description: Adds four to a 16-bit structure field, sets status flags, calls two helpers, and sets a global status bit.

key: frontier - elite ii (1993)(gametek)(disk 1 of 2)[cr csl]/Frontier - Elite II (1993)(GameTek)(Disk 1 of 2)[cr CSL].adf:Frontier:6:0A8E
name: notify_if_value_below_limit
description: When a 16-bit field is below a fixed limit and the input refers to a different structure, it calls a helper. If a value passed to it is below a threshold, it then calls an indirect method.

key: frontier - elite ii (1993)(gametek)(disk 1 of 2)[cr csl]/Frontier - Elite II (1993)(GameTek)(Disk 1 of 2)[cr CSL].adf:Frontier:6:0ABC
name: gate_category_and_scale_output
description: Returns the input unchanged when a table byte is zero or gating fields fail. Otherwise it sets status flags, selects coefficient pairs by a category value, computes a scaled product, and calls indirect methods that update a limited 16-bit field and return a shifted result.

key: frontier - elite ii (1993)(gametek)(disk 1 of 2)[cr csl]/Frontier - Elite II (1993)(GameTek)(Disk 1 of 2)[cr CSL].adf:Frontier:6:0C12
name: scale_table_value_into_field
description: Looks up a 16-bit value from a table by a category field and adds it to a structure field, either scaled by eight or taken from a shifted product with saturation on carry. It then calls an indirect method and returns its result shifted right by four.

key: frontier - elite ii (1993)(gametek)(disk 1 of 2)[cr csl]/Frontier - Elite II (1993)(GameTek)(Disk 1 of 2)[cr CSL].adf:Frontier:6:0C6E
name: add_shifted_product_to_field
description: Multiplies a 16-bit input by a scaled value from a table, shifts the product right by a table entry, and adds it to a structure field with saturation on carry. It then calls an indirect method and returns its result shifted right by four.

key: frontier - elite ii (1993)(gametek)(disk 1 of 2)[cr csl]/Frontier - Elite II (1993)(GameTek)(Disk 1 of 2)[cr CSL].adf:Frontier:6:0CB8
name: scale_product_into_field
description: Sets a status flag and computes a scaled product from two coefficient fields and a register input, storing it in the structure. It then calls indirect methods, adds a table value into a structure field when a category is in range, and returns a method result shifted right by four.
